from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "423")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "MC_VehicleVelocity")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

v = from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Main_Battery_Voltage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: "v"}))
i = from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Main_Battery_Current")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: "i"}))
union(tables: [v, i])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.v * r.i, _field: "Power"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "422")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "MC_BusVoltage" or r._field == "MC_BusCurrent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: r._field}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.MC_BusVoltage * r.MC_BusCurrent, _field: "Power"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
